questions.question: What did David and the leaders offer for building the temple?
options: Animals alone for all the daily sacrifices upon the altar
Nothing at all, leaving the whole cost to Solomon
Only their prayers and their heartfelt good wishes
Freewill offerings of gold, silver, and precious stones
questions.answer: Freewill offerings of gold, silver, and precious stones

questions.question: How does David describe the people's ability to give?
options: They gave from the tribute taken in battle
Their wealth was won by the strength of their hands
Everything comes from God, and they give of his own
Their riches came from the trade of the nations
questions.answer: Everything comes from God, and they give of his own
